description: Hello everyone! I am a Physics student at King Abdulaziz University with a background in data analysis and technical modeling. I am leading project SANA, a smart dashboard designed for early wildfire warning and tracking using NASA satellite data (NASA FIRMS) and the Global Wildfire Information System (GWIS).
summary:
SANA is a space-data platform for wildfire monitoring, built as a fast operational tool for civil defense teams and as a simple alert interface for the public. It aims to cut field response time by detecting active fire hotspots and estimating their spread from satellite data.

For civil defense and field teams, SANA tracks active thermal hotspots with precise coordinates using NASA FIRMS data. It integrates NASA POWER weather and wind data to assess fire spread speed and direction, helping teams deploy efficiently and safely. A central dashboard ranks alerts by risk level to support faster decisions.

For the public, SANA provides a simplified interactive map of active hotspots, is designed to send early warnings to people near danger zones, and makes it easy to follow local conditions.

By connecting open NASA data to the people who need it, SANA helps protect lives and property.
details:
How it works: SANA ingests satellite fire detections from NASA FIRMS (VIIRS and MODIS sensors) and combines them with weather and wind data from NASA POWER to estimate fire spread speed and direction. Civil defense teams see a central dashboard with hotspots ranked by risk level; the public sees a simplified map with early warnings for nearby danger zones.

Data: We used NASA FIRMS historical detections (2020-2024, August-September) and NASA POWER weather/wind data.

Intended impact: Faster field response, safer deployment of teams, and earlier warnings for communities, helping protect lives and property.

Creativity: One platform serving two audiences: an operational tool for responders and a simple alert interface for the public, built on open NASA data.

Tools: Programming Languages: Python, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript

Framework & UI Libraries: React / Frontend Web Components, Chart libraries (Recharts / Chart.js) for weather and fire activity graphs

Maps & GIS: Interactive Web Maps (Leaflet.js / Map APIs) for spatial risk monitoring and hotspot tracking

Data Sources & APIs: NASA FIRMS (MODIS & VIIRS sensors), NASA POWER & GWIS data

Hosting & Deployment: Manus Space Cloud Platform.

Factors considered: Usability for non-technical users, data accuracy, and speed of decision-making in emergencies.
dataRefs: NASA FIRMS (VIIRS & MODIS active fire data)
